title: Bulk deactivation confirmation shows its three lines in order
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BLINES-01) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BLINES-02) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
  • {Part-A} and {Part-B} share the start of their numbers (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BLINES-0), so one search lists them together.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab search the shared start (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-BLINES-0), open ⋮ and click "Deactivate parts".
  2. Tick {Part-A} and {Part-B} and click "Deactivate" in the bulk bar.
  3. Read the lines under "2 parts selected."
  4. Click "Cancel", untick {Part-B} and click "Deactivate" again.
  5. Read the lines, then click "Cancel".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: In this order: "These parts won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use them stay as they are.", "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected.".
  • Step 5: With one part ticked: "This part won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use it stay as they are.", "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R5, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.4 (Confirm), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R5: “For a deactivation from the bulk bar, the confirmation then states, in this order: "These parts won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use them stay as they are.", and "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." With exactly one part ticked, the lines read "This part won't show up ..." and "Existing records that use it stay as they are."”
